mechanism: Biotin at high doses (>5 mg daily) can interfere with immunoassays and laboratory tests including those used to monitor rilpivirine levels and viral load; additionally, biotin may affect gut pH and absorption dynamics relevant to rilpivirine's absorption requirements.
action: Monitor therapeutic drug levels of rilpivirine if biotin supplementation exceeds 5 mg daily; coordinate timing of biotin and rilpivirine dosing and inform laboratory of biotin use when ordering immunoassays.
